modules.module_title: Prepare for on-the-job training or simulated training

pcs.pc_description: obtain information of batch size, schedule of training, documentation and relevant materials from authorised sources
identify characteristics of audience to customize demonstration as per their needs
estimate equipment, materials and resources required to carry out demonstration and practice of work skills
organize for necessary and adequate equipment, materials and resources required
ensure that all equipment, materials and resources are ready to use and placed in a safe and learner friendly manner
notify learners of details regarding the implementation of the learning program and/or delivery plan

modules.module_title: Carry out on-the-job or simulated training

pcs.pc_description: share with the learners clearly, the acceptable standards of knowledge and performance to become competent
ensure that all learners have access to necessary equipment and materials for practicing on and learning the work skills
demonstrate each step in the task or procedure at a pace and manner that is easy for learners to follow
clarify queries and provide feedback on progress systematically
explain unfamiliar terms and jargons as and when they are used so that the learners can understand easily
state the precautions to be taken while performing the various steps
provide opportunity for each learner to practice each step in the task or procedure required to be learnt immediately after the demonstration if possible
observe learner performance and evaluate as per performance criteria
record and share feedback with the learners to support their learning as well as with management as per protocol
carry out post-training activities like proper storage of equipment and maintenance of records

modules.module_title: Prepare for undertaking assessment of competence as per standards

pcs.pc_description: schedule the assessments in between the training schedule as per requirement of the training plan
access and interpret units of competency that are to be used as benchmarks for assessment
prepare assessment tools to match the competency being evaluated and the parameters indicated in the checklist
ensure availability of necessary and adequate tools, equipment and materials for conducting assessment as per no. of candidates
ensure a safe and secure environment for the assessment to take place
provide instructions prior to assessment on the conduct of the assessment and assessment parameters

use assessment tools for various purposesVarious purposes: evaluate level of competence; evaluate learning retention; monitor learner progress against program and session objectives; identify learner learning needs against required curriculum; provide feedback to learners on progress; create development plan for further learning; assess learning styles; assess learner soft skills
gather evidence of performance applying the principles of assessment and rules of evidence
evaluate the collected evidence to check whether it reflects the evidence required to demonstrate competence
validate inferences made and finalize the results of the assessment
provide clear and constructive feedback to the candidate regarding the assessment decision, and clearly document follow-up, if required
complete learner assessment records accurately and submit or process as required in the required timeframes
use technology as applicable while conducting assessment activities (such as video evidence of skills/performance, recording of oral evidence, computer-based/on-line testing; etc.)
check and authenticate the video recordings and other evidences (for example, to see if there are no shortcomings), and retake the recording and evidences as applicable
document the results on paper templates as well as online forms and templates as prescribed accurately
complete candidate records accurately and process in the required time frame
secure, label and pack the evidences accurately as per standard procedures adopted by training organisation
